summary: CPA-licensed financial accountant with 5+ years of experience in financial reporting, management accounting, and royalty reporting for international licensing portfolios. Manages 150+ licensing and royalty reports for global brand licensors, applying AUS-IFRS, verifying sales against contract terms, and maintaining minimum guarantee monitoring tools. Background spans group financial statement preparation, foreign currency and banking reconciliation, AP/AR and payroll leadership, and general ledger maintenance. Holds a master's degree in accounting, is bilingual in English and Mandarin, and works effectively in multicultural teams.
